title: badf-git CLEAN: `badf_gate.py git-clean` classifies local branches and deletes only landed ones, with a recovery ref for each
objective: Close #338: git-cycle.md section 13 (CLEAN) allows deleting only local state proven landed, but nothing measures that. `git branch --merged` cannot see squash merges, the approved merge method, and a hand-run `git branch -D` records no before-state, recovery ref or work package. Add `git-clean` to the canonical control (GIT-I12): read-only classification by default, and preserve-then-guarded-delete under --apply --wp.
business_value: Local branch cleanup stops being a judgement call that can drop unlanded work or leave squash-landed branches accumulating. Every deletion becomes reversible from a named recovery ref and attributable to a work package, which is what the CLEAN exit condition ('reconciled without evidence loss') asks for.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: git_clean() and the `git-clean` subcommand -- PROTECTED / MERGED / SQUASHED / UNMERGED classification against origin/<default>, dry run writes no ref and no object, --apply --wp creates refs/recovery/<WP>/clean/<branch> then deletes with `update-ref -d <ref> <observed sha>`

tests/test_badf_git_clean.py: classification, no-write dry run, partial squash kept, missing target BLOCKED, --wp required, preservation and restore, existing recovery ref refused before any deletion, moved branch kept and HELD

acceptance_criteria: a branch is deleted only when MERGED (ancestor of origin/<default>) or SQUASHED (its net-diff patch-id is on origin/<default>); a partly landed squash is UNMERGED and kept
the default branch and every branch checked out in any worktree are PROTECTED and never deleted
without --apply, no ref and no object is written (for-each-ref and count-objects unchanged)
--apply refuses without a valid --wp; an existing recovery ref refuses the whole run before any deletion
each deleted tip is preserved at refs/recovery/<WP>/clean/<branch> and the recorded restore command recreates the branch at its SHA
a branch that moves after observation is kept (SKIPPED_MOVED) and the run is HELD (exit 3)
ADVERSARIAL: each of four seeded defects -- worktree protection removed, unguarded delete, squash check always true, no recovery ref -- turns tests/test_badf_git_clean.py red
evidence: compose output on the PR body

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; recovery refs created by --apply remain and restore any deleted branch

note: C1: a new operator command; no gate, schema, lifecycle or authority surface changes. The --apply path is GIT-O1 LOCAL_REVERSIBLE by construction -- nothing is deleted without first creating a recovery ref namespaced by the authorising WP. Prototyped in a Claude Code session scratchpad and moved into the canonical control at the operator's request, with the squash probe changed from a commit-tree object to a patch-id comparison so the dry run is strictly GIT-O0.
